title:
"/clear Exits Application Instead of Clearing Context"

This title succinctly describes the issue where the /clear command unexpectedly closes the entire application rather than simply clearing the current conversation context as a user would likely expect
body:
**Bug Description**
/clear exits, instead of just clearing the context

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 0.2.14
- Feedback ID: 567d14e3-509e-4d8a-92fc-b47e236bdd92
author: kaansenol5
